result.brief: BLD 将 1024 个 token 压缩为 64 个块潜变量，用并行分支自回归解码实现连续扩散语言生成，大幅降低 FLOPs 并提升吞吐。
result.reason: Continuous diffusion language model compressing token sequences into block latents with branching AR realization; directly addresses continuous language/latent modeling and efficient latent-sequence generation.
